title: A Resting-state EEG Dataset for Sleep Deprivation
description: This dataset contains resting-state EEG recordings from 71 participants collected under two conditions: normal sleep and sleep deprivation. Session order was counterbalanced across participants. Recordings cover eyes-open and partially eyes-closed rest, and the dataset also includes measures of participants' sleepiness and mood states.
methods_description: Data were collected between March 2019 and December 2020 using a Brain Products EEG system with 61 electrodes, sampled at 500 Hz, with impedances kept below 5 kΩ. Each participant completed a normal sleep session and a sleep deprivation session, with session order counterbalanced.

funding_references.funder_name: National Key Research and Development Program of China
